note: T-15 FAILS the 7-sigma gate: pooled over the 45-corner grid mean 31.9 ps, sigma 11.4 ps, sigma-to-spec 2.47 against 7; 0.4 % of draws fall outside the limit. The distribution is not normal (Anderson-Darling rejected), so the normal-model sigma-to-spec is indicative; the empirical yield is the tail used. Pooled grid, as for T-10.
